_about: Album record (Album Playbook, Nov 8): the proof for steps 1-8 that scripts/checks/album_gate.py checks and scripts/albumreview/build_review.py turns into the review page. One file per album: config/album-records/<set>.json. Paths are repo-relative. read_review.py appends to 'rounds' when her answers are applied.

Red Dragon: mulberry frame, gold dragon

picks.why: The teal-framed dragon in gold: her teal bams on a face.
Its mulberry twin: her back colour, framed.
The signature tile: a gold-winged crane with a teal crest.
A mulberry heart in a peacock crest: her back colour, in bloom.
The rose lion in teal stripes: her two colours, swapped.

holiday.note: All 221 visible holiday mats looked at on one contact sheet next to the Mulberry tiles: 3 in (Poinsettia Party, Winter Jewel, Yuletide), 2 near misses in Left out.
